 Al-Nassr 0 – 0 Live 5' Neom Live Updated a few seconds ago Al-Nassr vs Neom LIVE Updates, Game begins (0-0)
 The players took to the pitch and the ball rolled for the Al-Nassr vs Neom clash
 Coverage by Victor Cunha Updated October 20, 2026, 2:12 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 2:12 PM ET 5' 2:12 PM ET a few seconds ago Out
 On the counterattack Mohannad Abu Taha received the pass in front and shot hard from distance, but sending the ball out once again. Soon after, João Félix had the chance to shoot hard, also from distance, but sending the ball out.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 Follow VAVEL on Google 2:02 PM ET 10 minutes ago HERE WE GO
 The players took to the pitch and the ball rolled for the Al-Nassr vs Neom clash, in the first 45 minutes of this 10th round Saudi Pro League match, with all the action and excitement of the duel here on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2:00 PM ET 12 minutes ago Neom's bench
 For the game, Thierry Oleksiak will have the following names available during the match against Al-Nassr: Abdurahman Daghriry, Khalifah Al-Dawsari, Islam Ahmed Hawsawi, Khalid Al-Rammah, Faisal Al-Ghamdi, Valetin Vada, Giorgos Masouras, Haroune Camada and Muhannad Al Saad.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 ADVERTISEMENT
 1:52 PM ET 20 minutes ago Al-Nassr's bench
 For the game, Ange Postecoglou will have the following names available during the match against Neom: Adbulhadi Al-Alwan, Saad Al-Nasser, Majed Mohammed, Awad Aman, Yassine Sallem, Sami Al-Naji, Hayder Abdulkareem, Abdullah Al-Hamdan and Saad Haqawi.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 1:49 PM ET 23 minutes ago Neom lined-up!
 With a 4-4-2 formation, Neom's starting lineup for the Saudi Pro League match against Al-Nassr is: Bulka, Alburayk, Sarr, Zeze and Dossari; Al-Absi, Al Oyari, Alhassan and Taha; Benrahma and Lacazette.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 1:48 PM ET 24 minutes ago Al-Nassr lined-up!
 With a 4-4-2 formation, Al-Nassr's starting lineup for the Saudi Pro League match against Neom is: Bento, Boushal, Al-Amri, Iñigo Martínez and Yahya; Samú Costa, Ângelo, Al-Khaibari and Mané; João Félix and Cristiano Ronaldo.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 1:41 PM ET 31 minutes ago Good afternoon!
 We're starting the broadcast of the match, with all the action and excitement of the duel between Al-Nassr and Neom, in this 10th round of the Saudi Pro League, with the ball rolling at Al-Awwal Park, in this game between two top-of-the-table teams!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 1:30 PM ET 42 minutes ago Tune in here Al-Nassr vs Neom Live Score with VAVEL!
 We will soon share with you the starting lineups for the live match between Al-Nassr and Neom, as well as the latest information from Al-Awwal Park. Stay tuned for live match updates and commentary from VAVEL.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 1:18 PM ET an hour ago How to watch Al-Nassr vs Neom Live Stream and TV Online?
 If you want to watch the Al-Nassr vs. Neom game live on TV, your options are: FOX One.
 If you want to watch it via a streaming service or app, your options are: Fox Soccer Plus, fuboTV, and FOX Deportes.
 If you want to watch it online, VAVEL US is your best option!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 1:09 PM ET an hour ago Upcoming matches: when do Al-Nassr and Neom return to the pitch?
 After today's match, Al-Nassr returns to the field on the 23rd, when they visit Al-Faisaly in the Saudi Pro League, with the game taking place at 10:30 AM. Neom plays on the 24th, when they host Abha, with the ball rolling at 11:00 AM, also for the Saudi Pro League.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 12:53 PM ET an hour ago Al-Awwal Park: Let's go to Riyadh for today's game!
 Today's match takes place at King Saud University Stadium, also known as Al-Awwal Park, located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Home of Al-Nassr, the stadium was inaugurated in 2015 and has a capacity of over 30,000 spectators. It is expected to host matches of the 2027 AFC Asian Cup and the 2034 FIFA World Cup.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 12:43 PM ET an hour ago Neom's likely starting lineup for today is:
 On the other side, Neom, in their 4-0 victory over Shaab Hadramout, used a 4-4-2 formation, fielding the following players: Maximiano, Alburayk, Sarr, Dossari and Taha; Benrahma, Al-Ghamdi, Vada and Al-Absi; Saad and Lacazette.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 12:30 PM ET 2 hours ago Welcome!
 Al-Nassr vs Neom live face off this Tuesday (20), at Al-Awwal Park, for the Saudi Pro League. The match is valid for the 10th round of the competition, with all the action and excitement in real time here on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 12:30 PM ET 2 hours ago How does Al-Nassr arrive for today's clash?
 Al-Nassr comes to today's game with one defeat and two wins in the last games they played. On September 15, 4-0, Al-Ain lost away from home, in the AFC Champions League, with goals from Giakoumakis, Soufiane Rahimi and Houssine Rahimi (2). On October 9th, at home, the victory was 3-0 over Diriyah, with goals from Coman, Samú Costa and Cristiano Ronaldo. And on the 12th, 3-1, the victory came at home over Neftchi in the Champions League, with goals from Gofurov (own goal), Cristiano Ronaldo and Ângelo.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 12:30 PM ET 2 hours ago How does Neom arrive for today's game?
 Neom, for its part, comes into today's game with two wins and a draw. On September 13th, at home, they won against Al-Fateh 4-2, with goals from Vada, Lacazette (2) and Koné, while Kanga and Batna scored for Al-Fateh. On October 10th, they drew 1-1 with Al-Hazem, with Diakité opening the scoring and Benrahma equalizing for Neom. And on the 13th, they won 4-0 in the Gulf Club Champions League, at home, with goals from Lacazette (2), Al-Dossari and Benrahma.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 12:30 PM ET 2 hours ago Saudi Pro League: Here's how the standings look for today's game
 Al-Nassr is in third place in the Saudi Pro League with a 19-point lead, three points behind Al-Qadisiah, five points behind the leader Al-Hilal, one point ahead of Al-Ahli, two points ahead of Al-Ittihad, and three points ahead of Neom. Neom, in turn, is in sixth place with 16 points, one point ahead of Al-Ettifaq, and four points ahead of Diriyah, Al-Kholood, and Al-Khaleej.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 12:30 PM ET 2 hours ago Al-Nassr's likely starting lineup for today is:
 In their match against Neftchi, which they won 3-1, Al-Nassr used a 4-4-2 formation, fielding the following players: Bento, Boushal, Simakan, Iñigo Martínez and Aman; Coman, Samú Costa, Ângelo and Mané; João Félix and Cristiano Ronaldo.
